article 1 month ago Ways to Watch Live and original programming is available on the agency’s free streaming platform, NASA+. Programming is also available on the NASA App, third-party streaming services, and social media platforms. Social Media Facebook Twitch X YouTube VIDEO ON DEMAND NASA+ NASA+, the agency's ad-free, on-demand streaming service, requires no subscription. Programming includes livestreams of current space missions, original documentaries, and series made for kids. NASA+ is available on iOS, Android, web browsers, and media players such as Roku, Apple TV, and Fire TV.
